section_1.title: Introduction: The Creative Loop (0:00-0:45)
section_1.content: Define the goal: Converting text prompts into visual art. Introduce the two key players: CLIP (the 'Understanding' engine) and Diffusion (the 'Creation' engine).
section_1.example: A user types 'A cybernetic cat in a neon rainstorm'—show the AI breaking this into semantic tokens and visual pixels.

section_2.title: Prerequisite: The Concept of Latent Space (0:45-1:30)
section_2.content: Explain that computers don't see images; they see high-dimensional vectors. Visualize this as a 'Map of Concepts' where similar things (cats/dogs) cluster together.
section_2.example: Visualize a 3D coordinate system where the distance between the vector for 'dog' and 'wolf' is small, but 'dog' and 'spaceship' is vast.

section_3.title: CLIP: The Bridge Between Words and Vision (1:30-2:30)
section_3.content: Explain Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP). It aligns text and image vectors using Dot Product math (Similarity Scoring). If vectors align (high dot product), the match is perfect.
section_3.example: An animation showing a 'Text Vector' rotating to align perfectly with an 'Image Vector' until they point in the same direction.

section_4.title: Diffusion: The Mathematics of Noise and Recovery (2:30-4:15)
section_4.content: Explain the Forward Process (adding Gaussian noise until an image is pure static) and the Reverse Process (the model learning to predict/subtract the noise). Introduce the equation: x_{t-1} = μ(x_t, t, prompt).
section_4.example: Show a clear photo of a bird slowly dissolving into static 'snow' (forward) and then reconstructing itself from static based on the prompt 'a majestic eagle' (reverse).

section_5.title: The Synthesis & Conclusion (4:15-5:00)
section_5.content: Summarize how CLIP provides the target direction (the 'Loss Function') and Diffusion performs the iterative denoising to reach that goal. The result: emergent creativity from structured math.
section_5.example: Final montage: The noisy pixels refine into a crisp, stunning image of the cybernetic cat, proving how the math successfully translated the human prompt.
